flow-definition.description: On-demand + weekly btrfs dedupe of /mnt/btrfs (the docker/registry loop subvol). The CI image/node_modules workload dedupes ~2:1 — one pass reclaimed ~19 GiB (43->24 GiB) on 2026-05-18. Run this when disk-pressured or after big build-outs. Safe: btrfs FIDEDUPERANGE only shares byte-identical extents (data unchanged).
